flags: PRICE GATE: over $50 in every season. Cheapest real night is the Full Hookup Pull Thru at $63.78 (Motorhome, 23 ft, weeknights 2027-03-16 and 2027-04-13), $79.19 on 2027-07-13. Gateway exception applies by distance: gateways.py gives Indianapolis (metro), 22 km. Family has not stayed.

GOOGLE: 4.3 from 1,184 reviews, open. Read-so-so lines: 'The only negative was the noise from the interstate'; 'We ended up with a picnic table and fire ring for over $100'; on KOA's own page 10/23/2026: 'We would stay longer or more frequent but prices are high.'
PHONE: stored 800-562-0531 is KOA's reservation line. The park's own info line is 317-894-1397 (KOA general-information page, Google).
LONG-STAY: no issue. 'We do not offer monthly rates'; rates are nightly on the form.
PIN: good. Stored 39.81597,-85.91108 falls inside the campground on imagery (Google's place point is about 360 m south, in the field beyond it).
WATER: not waterfront stands. KOA mentions 'a meandering creek' to stroll along; no site type is tagged creekside and imagery shows only tree lines. Low-value lead.
